owner_calls.question: This also covers A:classic-loki and A:alligator-loki. These three Void Lokis have earth null, which means Earth-199999. HANDOFF says 'their files keep the Earth they come from', and Sylvie's file already carries her Marvel Database number (Earth-62171). network/rel/void_earths.json places all three in The Void and records these origin numbers. Should their file Earths be set to these numbers?
options: Keep null (Earth-199999) and leave the origin to void_earths.json
Set the earths: kid-loki Earth-TRN867, classic-loki Earth-TRN868, alligator-loki Earth-TRN869
owner_calls.evidence: Marvel Database pages Loki Laufeyson (Earth-TRN867) for Kid Loki, (Earth-TRN868) for Classic Loki and (Earth-TRN869) for Alligator Loki. The TRN numbers are the wiki's own temporary numbers, and it calls them unofficial.
